tools.name: search_events
tools.description:
Search things to do in Sweden on Agendan: concerts, theatre, markets, exhibitions, activities for children and more. Only upcoming and ongoing events are returned.

Use it for questions like "what's on this weekend near Kristianstad for a family with kids": place "Kristianstad", when "weekend", audi

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event on Agendan by id (from search_events, get_board or get_organizer): description, all occurrences, the venue, prices and tickets, organizers and the sources. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan". Link to the source as well.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search places to go to in Sweden: museums, theatres, bathing places, nature reserves, playgrounds and more. Give q (the name), a position (place or lat/lng), or both. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan". Show the attribution (for example OpenStreetMap) th

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: One venue by id (from search_venues or an event's location): address, position, kind, links and the number of upcoming events. Use search_events with venue for what is on there. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan". Show its attribution.

tools.name: search_areas
tools.description: Find Swedish areas by name: localities, districts, municipalities, counties, provinces and regions such as Österlen. Each has a position and a radius to search around. tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: Boards are collections of events on Agendan, such as "Christmas markets in Skåne", made by the editors or shared by users. tools.name: get_board
tools.description: One board by slug (from list_boards) with a page of its events. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan".

tools.name: get_organizer
tools.description: An organizer or performer by id (from an event's actors): name, city, links and upcoming events. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan".
